revised_prompt: A warm and elegant coffee shop grand opening poster in a vertical layout. At the top center, a large stylized title reads "晨光咖啡" in bold golden Chinese characters with a subtle metallic texture, flanked by delicate gold leaf ornaments on both sides. Directly below it, the subtitle reads "Grand Opening 12.01" in smaller dark brown serif type. Below the subtitle, a centered line of text states "Morning Light, Real Coffee" in a thin sans-serif font. In the upper-right corner, a small badge reads "EST. 2024" above a minimalist gold sun icon. The main visual is a photorealistic cozy coffee shop scene occupying the center and lower half of the poster: a steaming white ceramic latte cup on a wooden tray sits on the left, with the words "晨光咖啡" printed on the cup. Beside it sits a golden croissant and a plate of small cookies. On the right side, a rustic wooden window frame opens to a softly blurred street scene with a warm morning sun glowing through sheer white curtains. A small hanging sign near the top right of the window reads "OPEN" in gold. At the bottom left, a beige rounded rectangle information box contains three rows of details: "Location" with a map pin icon and the text "123 Morning Street, Sunshine City", "Opening Hours" with a clock icon and the text "Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM | Sat-Sun 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM", and "Follow Us" with social icons for WeChat, Instagram, and Facebook labeled "@ChenguangCoffee". At the bottom right, a deep brown rectangular card with gold foil trim contains a celebratory offer: a ribbon reads "GRAND OPENING OFFER", and the main offer states "Welcome Drink" above "50% OFF" in large gold text. A small gold line drawing of a coffee cup and a pastry accompanies the offer. The background features warm brown, cream, and golden tones, with a textured paper look, soft morning light, and clean professional typography.
